notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary interaction-class lookup across connection, membership, and additional-FOM composition boundaries. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador API and the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base FOM, extension FOM, endpoint, logical-time choice, and callback configuration. It verifies stable base and composed extension interaction handles, standard name round trips, and standard invalid-name and invalid-handle exceptions without provider-specific headers, registries, names, or diagnostics.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador interaction-class handle/name lookup across lifecycle and additional-FOM composition boundaries
